title: Invasion of Jersey (1779)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Invasion of Jersey (1779)", at revision 1370624028, opens: "The invasion of Jersey was a failed French attack on British-held Jersey in 1779, during the American Revolutionary War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5484470, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1779 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane kept by A15(6): it was derived from united-kingdom-q145, the country this event was placed at, and that place is refused while the lane it gave is right.
